{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA rows: revenue = 999999.99
qa_rows = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA rows (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_rows)}")
print("QA row examples:")
print(qa_rows[['order_id', 'channel', 'revenue', 'revenue_clean']])

# Filter out QA rows and refunded orders
valid_data = data[(data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Now group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = valid_data.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print results
print("Channel revenue (excluding QA rows, refunded orders, after cleaning):")
print(channel_revenue)

# Find the channel with the most revenue
max_channel = channel_revenue.idxmax()
max_revenue = channel_revenue.max()

print(f"\nChannel with most revenue: {max_channel} with ${max_revenue:,.2f}")"}
